Author: MormonFTP
Name: Drone Runner
Description:
For Cosmic Exploration on Oizys and Auxesia. Press Start on a crafter or gatherer and it uses a drone module, finds the artifact it located, travels there (with vnavmesh, on a mount for long trips), examines it, and goes again until your modules run out.
Without vnavmesh it flags each artifact on your map and examines it as soon as you get there.
It counts your gold, silver and bronze records as they come in.
Punchline: Runs Artifact Search for you: deploys your drone modules, walks to each artifact and examines it.

Author: MormonFTP
Name: Materia Transmuter
Description:
Tick the materia you don't want (Piety, say), stand next to Mutamix Bubblypots in Central Thanalan and press Start.
It talks to him, puts five of the same grade in the transmute window, confirms, and keeps going until your junk runs out.
It never touches materia you didn't tick, can keep a few of each, and logs what every trade gave you, grade-ups included.
Punchline: Feeds your junk materia to Mutamix Bubblypots, five at a time, for a shot at better ones.
